## carts/search

<a id="opIdquoteCartRepositoryV1GetListGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/V1/carts/search \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /V1/carts/search`

Enables administrative users to list carts that match specified search criteria. This call returns an array of objects, but detailed information about each object’s attributes might not be included.  See https://devdocs.magento.com/codelinks/attributes.html#CartRepositoryInterface to determine which call to use to get detailed information about all attributes for an object.

|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][value]|query|string|false|Value|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][conditionType]|query|string|false|Condition type|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][field]|query|string|false|Sorting field.|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][direction]|query|string|false|Sorting direction.|
|searchCriteria[pageSize]|query|integer|false|Page size.|
|searchCriteria[currentPage]|query|integer|false|Current page.|

`GET /V1/creditmemos`

Lists credit memos that match specified search criteria. This call returns an array of objects, but detailed information about each object’s attributes might not be included. See https://devdocs.magento.com/codelinks/attributes.html#CreditmemoRepositoryInterface to determine which call to use to get detailed information about all attributes for an object.

`GET /V1/customerGroups/search`

Retrieve customer groups. The list of groups can be filtered to exclude the NOT_LOGGED_IN group using the first parameter and/or it can be filtered by tax class. This call returns an array of objects, but detailed information about each object’s attributes might not be included. See https://devdocs.magento.com/codelinks/attributes.html#GroupRepositoryInterface to determine which call to use to get detailed information about all attributes for an object.

<h1 id="magento-b2b-invoicesid">invoices/{id}</h1>

## invoices/{id}

<a id="opIdsalesInvoiceRepositoryV1GetGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/V1/invoices/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /V1/invoices/{id}`

Loads a specified invoice.

<h3 id="invoicesid-parameters">Parameters</h3>

<h1 id="magento-b2b-negotiablequotepricesupdated">negotiableQuote/pricesUpdated</h1>

## negotiableQuote/pricesUpdated

<a id="opIdnegotiableQuoteNegotiableQuotePriceManagementV1PricesUpdatedPost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/V1/negotiableQuote/pricesUpdated \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "quoteIds": [
      0
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /V1/negotiableQuote/pricesUpdated`

Refreshes item prices, taxes, discounts, cart rules in the negotiable quote as per the latest changes in the catalog / shared catalog and in the price rules. Depending on the negotiable quote state and totals, all or just some of quote numbers will be recalculated. 'Update Prices' parameter forces refresh on any quote that is not locked for admin user, including the quotes with a negotiated price. The request can be applied to one or more quotes at the same time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "quoteIds": [
    0
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="negotiablequotepricesupdated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|

Lists orders that match specified search criteria. This call returns an array of objects, but detailed information about each object’s attributes might not be included. See https://devdocs.magento.com/codelinks/attributes.html#OrderRepositoryInterface to determine which call to use to get detailed information about all attributes for an object.

<h3 id="orders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][field]|query|string|false|Field|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][value]|query|string|false|Value|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][conditionType]|query|string|false|Condition type|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][field]|query|string|false|Sorting field.|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][direction]|query|string|false|Sorting direction.|
|searchCriteria[pageSize]|query|integer|false|Page size.|
|searchCriteria[currentPage]|query|integer|false|Current page.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» entity|body|[sales-data-order-interface](#schemasales-data-order-interface)|true|Order interface. An order is a document that a web store issues to a customer. Magento generates a sales order that lists the product items, billing and shipping addresses, and shipping and payment methods. A corresponding external document, known as a purchase order, is emailed to the customer.|

<h3 id="orderscreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» entity|body|[sales-data-order-interface](#schemasales-data-order-interface)|true|Order interface. An order is a document that a web store issues to a customer. Magento generates a sales order that lists the product items, billing and shipping addresses, and shipping and payment methods. A corresponding external document, known as a purchase order, is emailed to the customer.|

<h1 id="magento-b2b-ordersitems">orders/items</h1>

## orders/items

<a id="opIdsalesOrderItemRepositoryV1GetListGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/V1/orders/items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /V1/orders/items`

Lists order items that match specified search criteria. This call returns an array of objects, but detailed information about each object’s attributes might not be included. See https://devdocs.magento.com/codelinks/attributes.html#OrderItemRepositoryInterface to determine which call to use to get detailed information about all attributes for an object.

<h3 id="ordersitems-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][field]|query|string|false|Field|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][value]|query|string|false|Value|
|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][conditionType]|query|string|false|Condition type|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][field]|query|string|false|Sorting field.|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][direction]|query|string|false|Sorting direction.|
|searchCriteria[pageSize]|query|integer|false|Page size.|
|searchCriteria[currentPage]|query|integer|false|Current page.|

<h1 id="magento-b2b-products-render-info">products-render-info</h1>

## products-render-info

<a id="opIdcatalogProductRenderListV1GetListGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/V1/products-render-info?storeId=0&currencyCode=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /V1/products-render-info`

Collect and retrieve the list of product render info This info contains raw prices and formated prices, product name, stock status, store_id, etc

<h3 id="products-render-info-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|searchCriteria[filterGroups][0][filters][0][conditionType]|query|string|false|Condition type|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][field]|query|string|false|Sorting field.|
|searchCriteria[sortOrders][0][direction]|query|string|false|Sorting direction.|
|searchCriteria[pageSize]|query|integer|false|Page size.|
|searchCriteria[currentPage]|query|integer|false|Current page.|
|storeId|query|integer|true|none|
|currencyCode|query|string|true|none|

<a id="opIdcatalogBasePriceStorageV1UpdatePost"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/V1/products/base-prices \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{

      {
        "extension_attributes": {},
        "price": 0,
        "sku": "string",
        "store_id": 0
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /V1/products/base-prices`

Add or update product prices. Input item should correspond \Magento\Catalog\Api\Data\CostInterface. If any items will have invalid price, store id or sku, they will be marked as failed and excluded from update list and \Magento\Catalog\Api\Data\PriceUpdateResultInterface[] with problem description will be returned. If there were no failed items during update empty array will be returned. If error occurred during the update exception will be thrown.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "prices": [
    {
      "extension_attributes": {},
      "price": 0,
      "sku": "string",
      "store_id": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

<h1 id="magento-b2b-productscost">products/cost</h1>

## products/cost

<a id="opIdcatalogCostStorageV1UpdatePost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/V1/products/cost \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "prices": [
      {
        "cost": 0,
        "extension_attributes": {},
        "sku": "string",
        "store_id": 0
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /V1/products/cost`

Add or update product cost. Input item should correspond to \Magento\Catalog\Api\Data\CostInterface. If any items will have invalid cost, store id or sku, they will be marked as failed and excluded from update list and \Magento\Catalog\Api\Data\PriceUpdateResultInterface[] with problem description will be returned. If there were no failed items during update empty array will be returned. If error occurred during the update exception will be thrown.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "prices": [
    {
      "cost": 0,
      "extension_attributes": {},
      "sku": "string",
      "store_id": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

|cost_total|number|true|none|Total cost for quote.|
|created_at|string|true|none|The cart creation date and time.|

|negotiated_price_value|number|true|none|Negotiable price value for quote.|
|original_price_incl_tax|number|true|none|Original price with included tax for quote.|

Credit memo comment interface. After a customer places and pays for an order and an invoice has been issued, the merchant can create a credit memo to refund all or part of the amount paid for any returned or undelivered items. The memo restores funds to the customer account so that the customer can make future purchases. A credit memo usually includes comments that detail why the credit memo amount was credited to the customer.

Credit memo search result interface. After a customer places and pays for an order and an invoice has been issued, the merchant can create a credit memo to refund all or part of the amount paid for any returned or undelivered items. The memo restores funds to the customer account so that the customer can make future purchases.

|total_count|integer|true|none|Total count.|

Order address interface. An order is a document that a web store issues to a customer. Magento generates a sales order that lists the product items, billing and shipping addresses, and shipping and payment methods. A corresponding external document, known as a purchase order, is emailed to the customer.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_type|string|true|none|Address type.|
|city|string|true|none|City.|
|company|string|false|none|Company.|
|country_id|string|true|none|Country ID.|
|customer_address_id|integer|false|none|Country address ID.|
|customer_id|integer|false|none|Customer ID.|
|email|string|false|none|Email address.|
|entity_id|integer|false|none|Order address ID.|
|extension_attributes|[sales-data-order-address-extension-interface](#schemasales-data-order-address-extension-interface)|false|none|ExtensionInterface class for @see \Magento\Sales\Api\Data\OrderAddressInterface|
|fax|string|false|none|Fax number.|
|firstname|string|true|none|First name.|
|lastname|string|true|none|Last name.|
|middlename|string|false|none|Middle name.|
|parent_id|integer|false|none|Parent ID.|
|postcode|string|true|none|Postal code.|
|prefix|string|false|none|Prefix.|
|region|string|false|none|Region.|

Order interface. An order is a document that a web store issues to a customer. Magento generates a sales order that lists the product items, billing and shipping addresses, and shipping and payment methods. A corresponding external document, known as a purchase order, is emailed to the customer.

Order item interface. An order is a document that a web store issues to a customer. Magento generates a sales order that lists the product items, billing and shipping addresses, and shipping and payment methods. A corresponding external document, known as a purchase order, is emailed to the customer.

Order search result interface. An order is a document that a web store issues to a customer. Magento generates a sales order that lists the product items, billing and shipping addresses, and shipping and payment methods. A corresponding external document, known as a purchase order, is emailed to the customer.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|items|[[sales-data-order-interface](#schemasales-data-order-interface)]|true|none|Array of collection items.|
|search_criteria|[framework-search-criteria-interface](#schemaframework-search-criteria-interface)|true|none|Search criteria interface.|
|total_count|integer|true|none|Total count.|
